requirements.ask_text: Could you please tell me the last 4 digits of your phone number?

source.text: A. Security asks in this order: `phone_last4` FIRST, `date_of_birth` SECOND, `postcode` THIRD, `birth_year` FOURTH. Keep each question's wording and format. (P11 rule 11.4: `phone_last4` — ask for your phone last4. Format digits, exactly 4 digits including leading zeros.)

requirements.ask_text: Could you please tell me your date of birth?

source.text: `date_of_birth` — ask for your date of birth. Format date, sent as YYYY-MM-DD; a date given only as numbers is read day, then month, then year.

requirements.ask_text: Could you please tell me your postcode?

source.text: `postcode` — ask for your postcode. Format text: letters and digits, spaces removed.

requirements.ask_text: Could you please tell me your birth year?

source.text: `birth_year` — ask for your birth year. Format year, four digits.

identity.failed_instruction: Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.

source.text: 3 wrong answers TOTAL across the whole check, not 4.
E. Callbacks are for today or the next business day; the existing window remains. (P11 rule 6: from 12:00 to 17:30, both included, and later than `now`.)

third_party.deceased_sentence: I am sorry for your loss.

source.text: Wrong number: apologise and close as `no-contact` / `wrong-no`. The customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss." and close as `no-contact` / `deceased`.
Business days are Monday to Saturday, except Bank 1 holidays: 2026-10-14, 2026-10-15. "Next <weekday>" means that weekday of the following week, even when today is that weekday
| 1 to 10 | band1 | the last business day of next month | 2 |
B. For days late 11–60 only, the deadline is no longer the sixth business day after today but the third business day after today. (P11 table: | 11 to 60 | band2 | ... | 2 |)

The lowest amount this call may accept (the floor) is a fixed 75.00 for every product (or the full amount when that is lower); no bank field carries it. ... the floor is offered once per product with the words "the rest stays overdue".

A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline. A weekend day or holiday rolls to the next business day. A vague date (next week, when I get paid): ask once for the exact day; if none follows, propose the deadline. A date after the deadline: offer the deadline instead.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid the product.
special_cases.say: Payments can take one business day to appear.

source.text: Already paid: say "Payments can take one business day to appear.". Note the product as `already-paid` and continue with the other products.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer disputes the product: says it is not their debt, they never had the product, or it was closed or paid off before.

source.text: Dispute (not their debt, never had the product, closed or paid off before): note the product as `disputes` and continue with the other products.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer describes hardship such as illness, a death in the family, or job loss.
special_cases.say: I am very sorry to hear that.

source.text: Hardship (illness, a death in the family, job loss): say one short sentence of sympathy, make no persuasion attempt, and offer a transfer to the `welfare` team. If they accept, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `welfare` and close as `escalated` / `welfare`. If they decline, close as `no-ptp` / `vulnerable`. A customer in hardship may still name a date and amount; record it.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for a payment plan, lower instalments, or changing the terms.

source.text: Restructuring (a payment plan, lower instalments, changing the terms): call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `plans` and close as `escalated` / `plans`. Promises already recorded on this call stay recorded.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a human agent (during or after the identity check).

source.text: D. Human requests transfer immediately, without asking whether the assistant can help. (P11 rules 15/29: transfer to `front-desk` and close as `escalated` / `agent`.)

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The person suspects the call is a scam.
special_cases.say: You can verify this call by phoning Bank 1's customer service number.

source.text: If the person suspects a scam: say they can verify the call by phoning Bank 1's customer service number, and continue.

special_cases.name: robot
special_cases.trigger: The person asks whether this is a robot.

source.text: If asked whether this is a robot: say "I am Bank 1's digital assistant."
The customer refuses to talk: close as `no-ptp` / `refuses`.

special_cases.name: wrong_number
special_cases.trigger: The person says this is a wrong number.

source.text: Wrong number: apologise and close as `no-contact` / `wrong-no`.

special_cases.name: deceased
special_cases.trigger: The person says the customer has died.
special_cases.say: I am sorry for your loss.

source.text: The customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss." and close as `no-contact` / `deceased`.

special_cases.name: change_promise
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether a recorded promise can be changed.
special_cases.say: You can change it in the mobile app.

source.text: If the customer asks whether a recorded promise can be changed: say "You can change it in the mobile app."

table.when: A transfer, even after a promise.
No promise: reason of the first product in get_account order that is not paid.

source.text: CODE LIST C — authoritative enum combinations ... Only these combinations are allowed; omit reason where stated. (P11 rule 37: At least one promise recorded: `ptp-recorded`. A transfer: `escalated` with the transfer's reason, even after a promise. All products already paid: `already-paid`. No promise: `no-ptp` with the reason of the first product in `get_account` order that is not paid.)

Before closing a call that is not a transfer, add exactly one note (`add_note`) for each product without a promise, with the reason that applies: `refuses`, `vulnerable`, `disputes`, `already-paid`, `tool-error`. No notes on a transfer.

`get_account` returns up to 2 products. State every product with its past-due amount and days late, all before asking anything; then ask once whether they can pay all of it today. ... a common date is checked against each product's own deadline and clamped to it; one read-back covers all pending promises; a transfer after a recorded promise keeps the promise.

After verification say you are calling from the Bank 1 collections team about a late payment. ... then ask once whether they can pay all of it today.
C. After a failed create_promise retry once, not 2. (P11 rule 30: ask "Do you confirm?" ... one promise per product.)

The documents do not dictate a sentence for questions the assistant cannot answer. The only related instruction is for a failed promise write: 'say you could not record it' (rule 32), which the schema has no phrase field for.
